description: A walk around Courtown Harbour and Courtown Woods on the Wexford coast offers a delightful blend of coastal scenery and lush woodland. Starting at the picturesque harbour, you'll observe boats gently bobbing in the water, with the Irish Sea stretching out beyond. The harbour area is rich in maritime activity, reflecting its history as a bustling port. As you proceed into Courtown Woods, the environment transitions to a serene forested landscape. The woods feature well-maintained trails, including the River Walk and the Top Walk, both clearly signposted and mapped at the car park entrance. These paths meander through a variety of mature trees and saplings, creating a tranquil atmosphere. The woodland is home to diverse flora, with species such as Californian redwood, swamp cypress, and Japanese cedar, offering a rich tapestry of greenery. The fauna in the area is equally diverse. Birdwatchers may spot species like robins, blackbirds, and finches flitting among the branches, while the forest floor often reveals signs of small mammals. The presence of a murmuring stream running alongside parts of the trail adds to the natural charm, providing habitats for various aquatic creatures. Throughout the walk, you'll encounter scenic views that juxtapose the dense woodland with glimpses of the nearby coastline. The combination of maritime and forested environments makes this walk particularly appealing, offering a peaceful retreat into nature while remaining close to the coastal beauty of Wexford.
